title: A recording-chain peak is not a material identity
question: Can a known-input complex ratio recover the total transfer while leaving its physical factorization ambiguous?
model: y=d*e*x; d=[0.7,0.2,0.1]; e=delta[n]+0.6 delta[n-40]; * means linear convolution
estimator: Direct complex ratio FFT(y)/FFT(x), only on excited bins. No coherence or H1 averaging claim.
controls: Independent seed-B probe predicted from seed-A response
r=1 transfer zeros: identify and exclude from inverse-H, independently of input-X mask
Alternative d_alt=d*e and e_alt=delta produces identical outputs
limits: Known synthetic d permits a conditional echo calculation only
Single-path labels and physical echo parameters are not identified by total H
Exact noiseless finite FIR exercise; no device, pressure, material or biological validation
incomingEvidence: N5 distinguished actual WAV arithmetic and nonlinear observation operators. P2 identified physical factorization ambiguity and invalid single-record coherence language.
